items.title: Stella Oliver Interview, 1959-04-22
items.q: Well, I'm Stella Oliver, the widow of King Joe Oliver. We have been married, we married in 1912, July the 13th.

ctx.x: A little bit about your life too. We would be interested in knowing naturally too about your life and early albums when you were a girl. So if it's running okay, if you want. It's running okay.

Well, I'm Stella Oliver, the widow of King Joe Oliver. We have been married, we married in 1912, July the 13th. Was a fine man, a fine husband, and a fine musician. We got along beautifully together. We traveled around, had our ups and downs together, but we still stuck. And I'm happy to say this morning that I'm, I'm glad to say a few words about Joe. He's dead now, nearly 18 years. He died 38. And I miss him quite a night. I miss him up until now. However, his name has lived in the public. He was a great…
Or any of the brothers, or any of the other sisters, anyone else in the family living? Yes.
